conf.description: Ivanti ICS events JSON filter: deserializes the native JSON export; ECS/custom field mapping is NOT implemented because Ivanti publishes no key names for this filter (see README gap).

conf.comment: Ivanti ICS events, JSON filter. Key names are unpublished. Verifying on-device whether this form promotes the Integrity Checker result and file paths (SYS32039/SYS32040) into structured keys is the specific reason to capture this format - if so it is the one form making the highest-value record on this appliance queryable without a per-id msg regex. This pipeline deserializes JSON and tags event.dataset only. See ivanti-ics/README.md gaps.

functions.description: record the field-name gap up front
deserialize the JSON record so its native keys become individually queryable
tag the dataset; no other field is safe to map without a firmware capture
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
